description.text: This is a domain of seven transmembrane regions that forms the C-terminus of some subclass 3 G-coupled-protein receptors. It is often associated with a downstream cysteine-rich linker domain, NCD3G [pfam:PF07562], which is the human sweet-taste receptor, and the N-terminal domain, ANF_receptor [pfam:PF01094]. The seven TM regions assemble in such a way as to produce a docking pocket into which such molecules as cyclamate and lactisole have been found to bind and consequently confer the taste of sweetness [[cite:PUB00044748]].

wikipedia.title: Class_C_GPCR
wikipedia.extract: The class C G-protein-coupled receptors are a class of G-protein coupled receptors that include the metabotropic glutamate receptors and several additional receptors.

PUB00044748.title: Identification of the cyclamate interaction site within the transmembrane domain of the human sweet taste receptor subunit T1R3.
